meta.title: Happiness
meta.question: How happy are Poles?
meta.measure: Average happiness, from 0 (not at all happy) to 10 (very happy)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on how happy people are, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: Taking all things together, would you say you are very happy, quite happy, not very happy, not at all happy?
items.notes: EVS 1990, 1999, 2008, 2017. The 1999 British environment variant (v11_gb) is excluded by the ^ anchor.

items.wording: Taking all things together, how would you describe your present life: very happy, rather happy, not very happy, unhappy
Do you feel happy? (definitely yes, rather yes, rather no, definitely no)
Taking all things together, would you say you are very happy, quite happy, not very happy, not at all happy?
Taking all things together, how happy would you say you are? (0 extremely unhappy ... 10 extremely happy)
items.notes: ESS rounds 1-11 (2002-2023). Correlates 0.64-0.73 with stflife in every round (respondent level, unweighted); round 10 dips as stflife does (mode).

items.wording: Taking all things together, how happy would you say you are? (0 extremely unhappy ... 10 extremely happy)
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: Generally speaking, how happy are you? (1 not at all ... 10 completely happy)
items.notes: FNW SWPS online survey May 2026 only (code 1 label misspelt 'szczęśćliw', allowed for).
